notes.title: Whimsical Heroes now available in Early Access
notes.notes:
[p]We are very excited to announce that our latest game is now available for purchase on Steam! Whimsical Heroes launches in Early Access, giving us the opportunity to further develop and improve the game with the support of the community.[/p][p][/p][p]If you decide to purchase Whimsical Heroes now, you can get the game at a special launch discount![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683750/Whimsical_Heroes/" style="button"]Buy Whimsical Heroes[/url]
[/p][p]Whimsical Heroes is a tactical turn-based game where you lead a team of three heroes through the fairytale land of Whimsicalia in search of precious Bubbles. Simple rules make the gameplay light and accessible, while still offering surprising depth.[/p][p] [/p][p]In Early Access you’ll find:[/p][p]- Story Mode with dozens of handcrafted battles and exploration–narrative scenes,[/p][p]- Adventure Mode with randomly generated encounters that can be played multiple times to earn Development Points exchangeable for unique gameplay upgrades, [/p][p]- Three heroes, each with their own abilities and progression paths, [/p][p]- Three companions who provide bonuses during battles and can be upgraded as you play.  [/p][p]We hope you’ll enjoy the game and share your feedback with us so we can continue to improve and develop it in the best possible way.[/p][p]
And don’t forget – you can also try Whimsical Heroes for free by downloading the demo available on Steam:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465340/Whimsical_Heroes_Demo/" style="button"]Whimsical Heroes Demo[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/350c944b5e74df01c35debec8a0a47ef4ce3a193.jpg"][/img]
[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Launch Date!
notes.notes: [p]The moment we’ve been eagerly waiting for is finally coming: Whimsical Heroes, our long-awaited gem, will soon be available to purchase in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]Planned Early Access release date: September 22, 2025 [/p][p]Regular price: $9.99[/p][p][/p][p]We decided to release Whimsical Heroes in Early Access because, although small in scale, we believe the game already offers an interesting experience for players who enjoy tactical gameplay in a calmer, cartoony setting. With the feedback and support from players during this phase, we want to keep developing the title over the coming months and add content that best matches your expectations. Early Access will launch with the following content: [/p][list][*][p]Story mode! Dozens of handcrafted battles and exploration–narrative scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Adventure Mode, allowing multiple runs through procedurally generated battle sequences to earn Development Points that can be exchanged for unique gameplay upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Three heroes each with unique abilities and progression paths[/p][/*][*][p]Three companions, providing various bonuses during battles, which can be upgraded throughout the game[/p][/*][/list][p]Remember that if you want to check out the game for free, the demo is still available on Steam, and just got an update with some fixes and improvements to better reflect the state of the full game. [/p][p]We are extremely excited for our launch, as well as for all the content we plan to add. We hope exploring Whimsicalia brings you joy, and that you will actively take part in its growth and improvement.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun! [/p][p]The Whimsical Universes Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/7a934da39f3ad63e51804d81ae654b1adbfbb6ee.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Whimsical Heroes taking part in Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]We’re taking part in Steam Next Fest 2025 with our demo of [b]Whimsical Heroes[/b]![/p][p]Grab your baguette sword (or maybe a snack), gather your party, and step into a charming fantasy world full of turn-based battles, quirky characters, and tons of laughs.[/p][p]Try the [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683750/Whimsical_Heroes/"]Whimsical Heroes[/url] demo[/b] now during Steam Next Fest![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/10f28b35ebc00c6f098be3e33ed39adead7cbe5b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 1 Days Until the Whimsical Heroes heads to Next Fest - Meet Hedgepiglet
notes.notes:
[p]Meet Hedgepiglet, the dashing defender of the woods with a weakness for apples. By day, he sets mildly inconvenient traps for anyone who dares litter, shout, or disrespect tree boundaries. By night, he’s snacking upon “one or two” of his favorite apples and learning the woodland gossip. (Word is, a certain pumpkin witch has got a serious crush. It’s complicated.) Stay on the lookout for his traps, meant to trip up even the most daring adventurers.

Poised. Pointy. In need of some love advice. Encounter him and other adorable enemies in Whimsical Heroes, demo dropping TOMORROW, June 9, for Steam Next Fest!


[/p][previewyoutube="2oNma0KD1Yg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 2 Days Until the Whimsical Heroes heads to Next Fest - Meet Cucumberbatch
notes.notes:
[p]Cucumberbatch is usually pretty chill…until you trample his garden beds. Then it’s club time. With a head like a wrecking ball and the temperament of a hangry houseplant, Cucumberbatch doesn’t mess around. He uses his entire body like a club, body-slamming first, and asking questions never. But with such a pretty garden to protect, can you blame him?

Grumpy. Garden-enthusiast. Could benefit from anger management classes. Face his cucumber wrath when you play the Whimsical Heroes demo, dropping June 9 during Steam Next Fest!

[/p][previewyoutube="402KG9jPUqQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 3 Days Until the Whimsical Heroes heads to Next Fest - Meet Beenut
notes.notes: [p]Feared by many Whimsicalians (mostly due to nut allergies), beenuts are fast, flighty, and not above a bit of mischief. They’ll zip right past your defenses and leave your squad wondering what just happened. Sure, some say they’re criminals… but maybe they’re just misunderstood? You can decide during your own adventure in Whimsical Heroes.[/p][p][/p][p]Nut-shaped. Needy. Might just want a friend. Spot some beenuts among other silly foes when the Whimsical Heroes demo lands during Steam Next Fest on June 9![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ik5jXos5tjA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 4 Days Until the Whimsical Heroes heads to Next Fest - Meet The Storyteller
notes.notes:
Wielding a balalaika and the weight of a thousand tales, The Storyteller is an onion bard from distant lands, a mentor to both Champ and Catuldron, and a legend in his own right. With every strum, he weaves battles into ballads. His songs can stir the soul, lift spirits, or strike down foes from afar. 

Wise. Witty. A layered personality. Catch The Storyteller with his fellow adventurers when the Whimsical Heroes demo hits Steam Next Fest on June 9!

[previewyoutube=31hlxHCQkAE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 5 Days Until the Whimsical Heroes heads to Next Fest - Meet Catuldron
notes.notes:
Say hello to Catuldron, equal parts tank and cuddle buddy. With the fluff of a feline and the fortitude of a fortress, he’s been Champ’s best friend since kittenhood. At first glance, he may seem intimidating, but to his friends, he offers gentle cuddles, kind words, and warm purrs. In battle, Catuldron stands firm, shielding his squishier friends and taking on enemies with his powerful ball of yarn.

Soft. Strong. Slightly shaped like a soup pot. Catch him with his friends in action when the Whimsical Heroes demo drops June 9!


[previewyoutube=1HbTM_KDxP4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 6 Days Until the Whimsical Heroes heads to Next Fest - Meet Champion
notes.notes:
Meet Champion (or Champ, for short). A spirited young Beanling with more heart than height, he was raised in the royal court and named Champion by King Beanling III himself. Because he’s fast, fearless, and full of charisma, Champ boosts his allies and rattles his enemies with heroic flair, all while on the important mission of restoring the flow of Bubbles to the land of Whimsicalia!

Loyal. Lovable. A knack for making fast friends. Catch him and his companions in in our demo on June 9 during Steam Next Fest!

[previewyoutube=_LHekLd5wKw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Turn-Based Carnival - Whimsical Heroes Update
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of the new content patch for our demo as part of our participation in the Turn-Based Carnival on Steam!


In this update, we focused on enhancing skills. Both the heroes and their companions' skills can be developed while staying at the camp. Simply choose the equipment of the heroes near the campfire or one of the companions to open the development screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/258155170dfc40b74a2597856425041296acd829.png[/img]

Each learned skill has up to four different upgrades. Some increase damage, others reduce cooldown or required action points, while others give new properties to the skills. For example, upgraded Piercing will ignore the enemy's armor, and the False Note will hit more distant and numerous targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/3e11ab7acbca370c5f20d9ba4435bec049b9d64c.png[/img]

In addition to skill development, we also introduced improvements to the unit queue to support dynamic changes in initiative. And you know what? Chasing not only increases action points but also boosts initiative. Empowered by it, a hero will not only go farther but also earlier.

Last but not least, we've given a more unique atmosphere to the locations our heroes travel through. The forest is now darker, and Baba-Yaga's domain may seem a bit gloomy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/89cf5837080aa39c26ccff50c67924f481ae7ee7.png[/img]

Since the demo was released, we have already published several important updates. If you want to know more about the changes we're making, have access to behind-the-scenes work, and influence the development of Whimsical Heroes, join our [url=https://discord.gg/7gHKxVYGyT]Discord[/url] now.

notes.title: Whimsical Heroes Demo is now available!

We are thrilled to announce that the Whimsical Heroes demo is now available on Steam!

The demo lasts about 20 minutes. In this short linear adventure, we introduce the three main heroes and the core mechanics of the game. Feel free to leave any thoughts and suggestions. We are looking forward for your feedback!

You can also let us know how you liked Whimsical Heroes on our [url=https://discord.gg/7gHKxVYGyT]Discord[/url].

notes.title: We are now Whimsical Heroes!
notes.notes:
From now on, all information regarding the game will be published under the new title “[b]Whimsical Heroes[/b]” that replaced the name "Bubbleland".

We assure you that the change is purely cosmetical, and the idea behind the game stays the same. Whimsical Heroes will be the same cartoonish and wacky take on dynamic turn based battles with unique heroes. The new name, as we believe, better suits the game’s tone and is more descriptive.

The changes affected all our social media, you can find below - we strongly encourage you to follow them all for all the news and announcements:

notes.title: Development of Bubbleland
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Bubbleland is an independent game, a passion project, which we carry out in our spare time. Although working in a tiny team is quite challenging, a great creative freedom is one of its advantages. 

Today we would like to tell you what stage of production we are at.

[list]
[*]The game is functional already, most of the mechanics have been implemented, and now the biggest challenge is, and will be until the end of production, creating the game content - graphics, sounds, music and encounters.
[*]Recently, the game has been enriched with a lot of new graphic and animation assets of characters, items and background elements. The background itself moves more beautifully than ever during the character's journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/f09f54c6084089398a181b816bfd6be5f23e85ff.gif[/img]

[*]The system of the adventure scenes has changed! Player's party will not only fight battles, but also search the levels for  treasures, interact with other characters and choose the paths they want to follow.
[*]Battle music now changes dynamically depending on which side of the conflict is closer to victory.
[*]Existing battles have had their difficulty balanced, and opponents have gained new skills.
[*]Countless improvements to the game's operation and the display of the interface have been implemented. 
[/list]
Thanks for your interest in our game! If you want to support us more, add Bubbleland to your Wishlist - it motivates us to further work and shows that there are people waiting for us to provide them with the best possible experience.

Also check out our other social media, where we will share further information and behind the scenes materials:
[b][list]

notes.title: The Journey begins
notes.notes:
Welcome everyone!
We are happy to finally announce Bubbleland!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/61dc01c2bee357c8ea88c5f78cdf2e084f44482e.png[/img]

Bubbleland is a cute little game that makes tactical battles less complicated and more fun. If you've always liked turns and hexes, but aren't interested in exploring stat sheets and optimal character builds, you'll love this little cartoonish game. 

The game is all about simplicity, but the gameplay lacks no depth. We believe Bubbleland can offer you a variety of tactics, impressive skill combinations and exciting face offs, without requiring you to painstakingly learn the intricacies of the combat system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/0bb3bea76ee5be61481b972a56344595ddb6ebf3.gif[/img]

Key features of Bubbleland: 
[list]
[*] simple but clever gameplay, easy to learn but engaging for hours
[*] variety of available tactics, to keep things interesting all the time
[*] colorful, cartoonish setting, ‘cause not everything has to be realistic, dirty and gray 
[*] light and humorous story, to take a break from tension and seriousness
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143219/f4f0e6a1aa08d8071ad6e05f41fc22d29fa00341.gif[/img]

Feel free to leave suggestions and any sort of feedback on our game in this Steam Community channel.

Wishlist Bubbleland now - it helps us a lot - and stay tuned for further updates!
